mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_message (user_id, message_id, is_read, read_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{messageId}, #{isRead}, #{readAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO user_message (user_id, message_id, is_read, read_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{it.userId}, #{it.messageId}, #{it.isRead}, #{it.readAt}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO user_message (user_id, message_id, is_read, create_time, update_time) SELECT #{userId}, m.id, 0, NOW(), NOW() FROM message m WHERE m.broadcast = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_message um WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.message_id = m.id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
SELECT m.type AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_message um JOIN message m ON m.id = um.message_id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.is_read = 0 GROUP BY m.type
